scope_description: The two backlog fixes landed 2026-08-16: gate-help-drift (ghd-1, help payload + drift test) and guard-refusal-wording (grw-1, unresolvable Bash target refusal wording), cumulative diff from before the first merge to the second merge commit
head: 90dd70aa8ff0d0bbec98214745f342d90aa25aa5

findings.claim: D1 shell-syntax classification reaches the Edit/Write/MultiEdit and apply_patch surfaces: a literal file named with $ or backquote flips allow-to-deny with the forbidden containment wording, and zero tests cover any non-Bash surface
findings.evidence: hook_local.rs:238,:298 shared resolvers; main.rs:156,:267 call sites; differential old-allow/new-deny proven by two reviewers; tests.rs additions are bash() only
findings.remedy: fix cell: scope classification to the Bash branch (or bash flag param); add edit()/patch() twins of the three Bash tests; decide and pin the Edit-surface wording

findings.claim: With .bee/companion-session.json present, a shell-syntax target the old binary denied natively now returns Delegate and the dispatcher fail-opens to allow (exit 0) — a new allow on a guard path
findings.evidence: companion_mount_rel Err(Nd) -> hooks/mod.rs:138 emit_undecidable; differential old exit 2 / new exit 0 proven; matches critical pattern: a fail-open host swallows fail-closed throws into an allow
findings.remedy: fix cell: shell-syntax classification must deny before the companion branch (never delegate an unresolvable token); add expect_delegate/deny test for companion-marker + $VAR

findings.claim: Drift test hardcodes KNOWN_FLAGS as a const copy of set_gate.rs keys_known: it catches a payload deletion but cannot catch a NEW handler flag shipping unlisted — the exact defect p-62f0566d named can recur
findings.evidence: registry_contracts.rs:169-179; corroborated independently by two reviewers; kept P2 by severity definition (no shipped behavior wrong) despite the corroboration-promotes rule — named deviation
findings.remedy: derive the list from include_str of set_gate.rs per opencode_plugin_contracts.rs:163 precedent; optionally add exact-set and reverse-direction (declared-but-rejected) assertions

findings.claim: Refusal echoes the raw token verbatim, unbounded and unescaped, to stderr (quoted tokens may carry newlines/control chars)
findings.evidence: hook_local.rs:41-49; main.rs:464-467; guards.rs:283-292 tokenizer preserves newlines inside quotes
findings.remedy: bound token length and strip control characters in the message

findings.claim: A genuinely literal $ filename has no compliant Bash spelling and the FIX line prescribes expanding a variable that does not exist; quoting/escaping collapse post-tokenize
findings.evidence: hook_local.rs:33 post-tokenizer classification; probes C/D identical refusal
findings.remedy: message names the literal-$ case; tokenizer work stays out of scope per CONTEXT

findings.claim: Mixed command: an unguarded check_write loop overwrites the D2 resolution-failure message, so the operator never learns the unresolvable target
findings.evidence: main.rs:313-332 loop not guarded by denial.is_none(); probe K
findings.remedy: guard the loop or prefer the earlier denial; add mixed-command test

findings.claim: The backlog items second symptom remains: a mis-extracted non-path token (cp source operand, find {} braces) is still named as a path in refusals; p-aa37ec95 was closed with the remainder split to a new extractor PBI
findings.evidence: probe G writing {} is refused; follow-up PBI filed 2026-08-16 for extractor operand roles
findings.remedy: the filed extractor PBI covers it; no further action in this scope

findings.claim: Two new tests use the message function itself as their own expectation (self-referential assert_eq); only the contains() lines pin real content. Pre-existing guard family gaps put on record: brace expansion not classified, cd not modelled
findings.evidence: tests.rs:2869,:2880; no { handling and no cd handling in guards.rs
findings.remedy: pin literal message fragments; consider extending has_unexpanded_shell_syntax to brace/glob metacharacters and a cd-in-segment opaque flag as future work
